keywords_en: EIP-8130 adjusts the account config interface

summary_en: chunter-cb adjusted EIP-8130's account config interface, submitted and merged. SirSpudlington submitted a change moving EIP-6404's secp256k1 algorithm ID from 0xFF to 0x00. nerolation aligned EIP-8037 with EIP-7928's gas validation phases, merged. gakonst open sourced the Tempo Wallet CLI with built in MPP payments. ethresear.ch published Outcome Preconfs, verifying block commitments without the block.
